# Khronos reference fixtures

Source: [glTF Sample Assets at 8f492390ddc7a2ae221a1369ef560589cf8c70fb](https://github.com/KhronosGroup/glTF-Sample-Assets/tree/8f492390ddc7a2ae221a1369ef560589cf8c70fb).

External buffers and images are embedded as data URIs. Geometry, material properties, transforms and animations are unchanged. Tests repack these fixtures as GLB and merge buffers in memory. This packaging adaptation does not add runtime external-resource or multiple-buffer support. Source and vendored SHA-256 hashes are recorded in `test/reference-assets.json`.

Upstream attribution follows. SimpleSparseAccessor also declares CC0 in its License Information section; its generated Legal section declares CC BY 4.0, retained below.
